candidate_universe.source: existing fixed inventory scope, not observed successful records

pairing.source: non-outcome design and bed lineage only
pairing.orientation: second minus first, assigned by design labels before value access
pairing.zero_delta_N: preserve pair; omit from nonzero-N directional summary

N_proposal.primary: original endpoint damping-group surviving count, if group and membership are defined and evidenced
N_proposal.secondary_candidate: surviving stable IDs from last-moving damping reference group

uncertainty_proposal.independent_unit: original bed/insertion lineage; shared lineage, seed and pair reuse declared
uncertainty_proposal.reporting_unit: all prespecified pairs and lineage/stratum-level points and ranges

state_semantics.NOT_ESTABLISHED: required evidence or qualification is missing
state_semantics.UNDEFINED: quantity or group definition is established to be inapplicable or undefined
state_semantics.NOT_IDENTIFIABLE: independent N effect cannot be separated in the stated design

decision_recommendations_not_approvals.lhs_inventory: separate per-host explicit author GO for existing fixed value-suppressing inventory only, after identity and command hash checks
decision_recommendations_not_approvals.A_C: inventory first; A if original-log identity and chain suffice, otherwise C amendment with tests and independent review
decision_recommendations_not_approvals.value_access: after frozen cohort/overlap/pair/strata/exclusions/endpoint/N/reporting and A/C ratification, separately scoped collection
decision_recommendations_not_approvals.user_reported_resource_context: ibb idle, qos cpu-60; not independently checked and not an allocation or GO
